source: docs/gx10_results.md (GX10 night run, Oct 24; raw runs BM-9ee343b1, BM-eef5c303, BM-0ecb4209 and results/judge_load_*.json are gitignored)

machine.name: NVIDIA GX10 (ASUS Ascent)
machine.serving: Ollama 0.40.7, reached over Tailscale through an SSH tunnel (scripts/gx10.sh)
machine.air_gapped: FLOCK_AIRGAP=1: every model call stayed on the network (0 left)

speed.what: seconds per finding through the full 3-judge panel (scripts/judge_load.py), p50

benchmark.what: held-out seeds 101-103 (never trained on): 142 findings, 916 answer-key trap rows, ca_bagel_chain 56 stores x 14 days; same findings and prompts for every contestant
not_run: Claude (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY that night; recorded as skipped, not replaced)
benchmark.note: Caught counts answer-key rows, dominated by one trap (processing_fee_creep, 765 of 916 rows). The mixed panel's 92 is caution (one skeptical judge sends a finding to a human), not error: no contestant filed a false alarm.

training.method: LoRA r16 / alpha 32 / dropout 0.05 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down (40.4M trainable params, 0.53%), bf16
training.data: scripts/judge_dataset.py seeds 1-50: 2,294 findings, 6,156 train / 726 val examples; held-out benchmark seeds 101-110 locked out
training.trained_on: 1 epoch over 2,400 sampled examples (150 steps), lr 2e-4 cosine
training.serving: merged adapter -> GGUF q8_0 (llama.cpp) -> ollama create flock-judge-v1 (8.1 GB)
training.caveat: Labels are synthetic and reasons templated, so the model learns the answer key's mapping on this simulated data, not open-ended judgment.
